title: Fabula Ultima PDF Importer
description: Import creatures from your Fabula Ultima PDFs (Core Rulebook, Bestiary, High, Natural and Techno Fantasy Atlases) as Project FU NPCs: every stat block with its attacks, spells, other actions, special rules, Affinities and immunities, and every creature's art, portraits and illustrations alike, including art split across two-page spreads.
